quantifiers.matrix: A in R^(m x n), row sparsity r <= n

guarantee.output: a nonnegative weight vector defining an epsilon-approximate GLM sparsifier
guarantee.runtime: O~((n^omega + n r^2 + r sqrt(mn)/epsilon) log(s_max/s_min))

named_algorithm_obligations: The cited MultiSample theorem assumes 1 <= k <= input-vector length m.
Algorithm 2 explicitly processes i=1,...,M before returning a classical weight vector.
falsification_condition: An assumption-satisfying parameter family for which the named algorithm invokes MultiSample outside its stated domain and its explicit processing lower bound grows as epsilon^-2 while the claimed runtime grows only as epsilon^-1 up to polylogarithms.
negative_control: At epsilon=sqrt(n/m), normalized M=m and M equals the r sqrt(mn)/epsilon term for r=1, so neither contradiction is present.
